_about: Parameters of tools/pipeline/blender_mannequin.py (M4-plan.md Part C section 5 step 2, as amended by A2 step 3): the joint table as a chunky grey mannequin in a 45 degree A-pose, rendered orthographic from the front, the left and the back at 3:4, 2K. The numbers live here, not in the script. Rerun: blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python tools/pipeline/blender_mannequin.py -- assets/source/mannequin/mannequin.json assets/source/mannequin

pose.name: a_pose
pose.note: Each upper arm swings out about the rig's Z axis so it points this many degrees below horizontal; the forearm and hand continue straight along it. The legs stay parallel at the table's x = +-0.11.

hand.note: An open mitten in place of the fist box (A13: views keep open hands). Palm to the body, thumb forward (-Z). Axes are the Hand bone's: the hand hangs along -Y from the wrist.

nose.note: A small wedge so the front of the head reads in the left view.

loft.note: The boxes that make the torso, pelvis to upper chest, become one smooth superellipse loft (exponent 2 is an ellipse, higher is boxier). BellyTop, the cylinder that rounds the belly's top, is in skip_parts.

blend.note: The overlapping parts are melted into one shell (a voxel remesh) and smoothed, so the torso reads as a body and not as stacked slabs; voxel_m 0 keeps the separate parts.

views.name: front
views.note: the camera stands in front of the character (it faces -Z); the character's own right is on the image's left

views.name: left
views.note: the character's own left side; it faces the image's left

views.name: back
views.note: from behind; the character's own right is on the image's right
